name: RTL
summary: Reference pack for register-transfer-level hardware design and verification tasks.

tool_probes.description: Check whether Verilator appears available; do not install or execute generated code without normal task confirmation.
Check whether Icarus Verilog appears available; do not install or execute generated code without normal task confirmation.
Check whether a SpinalHDL/SBT toolchain appears configured; do not install dependencies.

checklist: Identify whether the requested design is combinational, sequential, or mixed.
Name the target HDL: Verilog, SystemVerilog, or SpinalHDL.
For sequential logic, define clock/reset polarity, synchrony, and initialization assumptions.
Separate synthesizable design code from testbench code.
Require simulator evidence such as a command, log, waveform note, or stated blocker.
Use metadata-only tool probes; do not install simulators or execute remote pack code.
